summary: A dermatology, plastic surgery and pharmacy offer with WhatsApp booking is a strength, but dead menus and three different WhatsApp numbers appear to confuse patients.

findings.problem: The About, Departments and Media menu items link to #.
findings.cost: Visitors cannot reach your main sections from the menu.

findings.problem: Book Now sends people to +974 5147 5954, Appointments to +974 5025 6513 and the footer to +974 4408 9701.
findings.cost: Patients do not know which number is the right one and some will give up.
findings.fix: One clear booking number and a booking form.

findings.problem: The page says Make an Appointment Friend, keyword phrases such as dermatologist near me are repeated in the text, and the hours omit Saturday.
findings.cost: Odd copy and missing hours cost bookings.
findings.fix: Clear, proofread copy and complete hours.

findings.problem: The rating shows 4.4 from 99 reviews but only a few appear, several reviews have no text, and staff names vary between Dr. Shin and Dr. Nashat.
findings.cost: Thin proof and changing names weaken your strongest asset.
findings.fix: A full review wall and consistent staff names.

redesign: Working menus and one booking number with a form.
Proofread copy with complete opening hours.
A full review wall and consistent staff profiles.
